question: Do the two fixed public actions permit pooling equal-prior one-edge sectors under an action-preserving relabeling, and does a prospectively chosen highest-prior two-edge sector yield a useful first-record omitted-error bound without new Born laws?

hypotheses.fixed_action_obstruction: The singleton action fixes red edge 0 and the five-edge action fixes its membership set, forcing at least three one-edge action-membership classes; prior/base-likelihood equality alone cannot pool fixed-action second laws.
hypotheses.tail_tightening: Commuting first-star one-site constraints lower the highest-prior two-edge sector's omitted posterior bound below the J8Q worst-case omitted-prior bound.
hypotheses.tail_insufficient: The structural bound remains too loose; retain it as a negative single-record result without adding errors, records or budget.

frozen_model: R6AF ideal periodic L=2 D4 orbit, 36 IID red-X physical edges at p_X=1/10 and p_Z=0. J6O signal-only pre-action full-binary first record, charge all zero and vacuum=1-charge; fixed relation-free public charge actions [0] and [1,30,32,34,35] bind the action-conditioned full-binary second flux. Private error supports and the prospectively chosen two-edge representative remain generation/scoring-only, never action input. No second charge law, noisy history, logical score or threshold is evaluated.

branches: On all 36 one-edge first-flux representatives, compute each edge's membership in both fixed public action sets and both action-conditioned second-flux masks. Prove only the necessary fixed-action obstruction and exact class prior mass, not a geometric/operator automorphism.

Among the 630 J8P two-edge sectors, select the maximum exact sector prior before examining omitted likelihoods, breaking ties by lexicographically smallest base edges. Reuse its J8Q exact complete first mass. Enumerate all 8,192 compatible private errors; apply commuting one-site first-projector domination to prior-weight the omitted likelihood upper U, compare U/(A+U) to J8Q's crude upper, and stop.
matrix.independent_unit: One fixed one-edge public action-binding signature in branch one; one of 8,192 private physical supports in the frozen selected two-edge first-flux sector in branch two. Exact rational arithmetic, no stochastic uncertainty.
matrix.integrity: Pin all source and result inputs and runner; verify 36 unique one-edge sectors with equal exact prior, action signatures (1,5,30), 36 distinct second-flux masks under each fixed action, deterministic two-edge selection, rank 23/nullity 13, 8,192 unique same-flux errors, eligible-site/public-flux consistency, all first-star pairwise commutation, exact sector-prior replay, prior partition, J8Q base mass replay, upper-bound monotonicity, hash stability and zero new Born work.

acceptance: Exact necessary fixed-action one-edge membership partition and action-conditioned second-flux distinctness, without an operator-law symmetry claim
Exact one-site omitted-joint/posterior upper certificate for the prospectively selected highest-prior two-edge first record, compared with J8Q crude bound
No omitted complete law, second charge law, full-IID information/risk, noisy JIT or threshold claim
stop_rule: Stop after both bounded branches or the first integrity/CPU cap. Do not add another two-edge sector, alternate first record, new Born law, action, history, bootstrap, or budget. A loose upper bound is retained as a negative result; action-set membership is necessary only, not a full symmetry classification.
